name: Gudmar
actions: Blunts the taste of sugar when chewed
kitchenUse: Not a kitchen herb; chewing a leaf briefly stops sweet foods tasting sweet. Taken as powder or tablets.

typicalUse.adultAmount: Only as a qualified practitioner advises; products and strengths vary
typicalUse.note: Never replace diabetes medicines with gudmar.

cautions.note: Can lower blood sugar; check levels closely and tell your doctor if you take it.
Not enough is known; avoid in pregnancy and while breastfeeding.
May affect blood sugar control around surgery; stop two weeks before.
Rare cases of liver injury have been reported with gymnema products.

interactions.effect: May lower blood sugar too far when combined with diabetes medicines.

evidence.summary: Small, mostly older trials suggest modest drops in blood sugar; better trials are needed.
